dialogues.speaker: Tolstaya
dialogues.text: Welcome! What would you like to have? Order anything you like!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like to see the menu...

dialogues.speaker: Tolstaya
dialogues.text: Of course it does! This is Miss Vodyanitsa, Miss Odette, and Mr. Alyosha's...

dialogues.speaker: Tolstaya
dialogues.text: #...Ah! Y-You're {NICKNAME}, aren't you? Miss Vodyanitsa told me about you.

dialogues.speaker: Tolstaya
dialogues.text: She said you have wonderful taste, and that you're a very kind person. This restaurant only looks as good as it does thanks to your help.

dialogues.speaker: Tolstaya
dialogues.text: Take care. We look forward to your next visit!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I didn't do anything that impressive...

dialogues.speaker: Tolstaya
dialogues.text: So modest, too! Miss Voyanisha mentioned that as well. You really are just like she said.

dialogues.speaker: Tolstaya
dialogues.text: Are you here to order something? In that case, please have a look at the menu. I promise I'll use only the finest ingredients!
